    cluster_identifier TEXT,
    first_detected TIMESTAMP,
    member_count INTEGER,
    max_coord_score NUMERIC,
    member_accindexes TEXT[]
);
INSERT INTO audit_amplification_networks

    a.platident as cluster_identifier,
    MIN(sd.detecttime) as first_detected,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.accindex) as member_count,
    MAX(ma.coordscore) as max_coord_score,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT a.accindex) as member_accindexes
FROM moderationaction ma
JOIN contentbehavior cb ON ma.macntref = cb.cntref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON cb.cntsessref = sb.sessref
JOIN profile p ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
JOIN account a ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
